_doc: Hero legacies (Systems/Legacies.cs). Heroes who fall at minLevel or above enter the hall of heroes (Chronicles). One who fell at heirLevel or above may leave an heir (heirChance + heirChancePerRenown per point of renown, up to heirChanceMax; if none comes, a memorial brings word to the kin with memorialHeirChance), who comes heirDays later at heirLevelShare of their level with the fallen's best magic item and heirLoyalty more loyalty. A memorial costs memorialCost + memorialCostPerLevel per level, adds memorialMandate, and every memorial gives every hero memorialLoyalty loyalty, up to memorialLoyaltyMax. Heroes of retireLevel with retireExpeditions behind them may be asked to retire by a story; each retired master of arms gives new heroes mentorXp of the XP to their next level, up to mentorXpMax. The stand-in mayor raises a memorial when the treasury holds standInTimes its cost plus standInReserve, standInAfterDays after the death.
